findings.evidence: Repo canonical spelling: SlashActionRat.lean:84 (`monoidHomSlashAction (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.map (algebraMap ℚ ℝ))`), :96 `rat_slash`, :100-101 `det_map_ratCast_pos`, :121-123, :152-153 `map_ratCast_mem_SL`, :159 `exists_mem_SLnZ_of_mem_SL`; Form.lean:43 also names `Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.map (algebraMap ℚ ℝ)` as "already the map". Defeq only: Mathlib/Algebra/Algebra/Rat.lean:58-60 `instance DivisionRing.toRatAlgebra ... algebraMap := castHom _`. SlashActionRat.lean:88-90 states the repo's policy of naming the transport rather than leaning on defeq.
findings.fix: State it as `IsCusp (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.map (algebraMap ℚ ℝ) g • c) Γ` (name can stay). `DivisionRing.toRatAlgebra` sets `algebraMap := Rat.castHom _`, so the existing proof needs at most a `show`/`Rat.coe_castHom` bridge, and the HeckeSlash call sites are unaffected.
findings.issue: The conclusion `IsCusp (g.map (Rat.castHom ℝ) • c) Γ` uses a spelling of the GL(2,ℚ) → GL(2,ℝ) map that occurs nowhere else in this development; every other declaration in the rational-slash ecosystem writes `Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.map (algebraMap ℚ ℝ)`. The two ring homs are only definitionally equal, so the lemma composes with the existing API by defeq (`exact`) but not syntactically: a goal produced by `ModularForm.rat_slash` carries `map (algebraMap ℚ ℝ) g` and will not match this statement under `rw`/`simp`.

summary: Surface is minimal, bodies stay hidden and the rename leaves no compatibility shim. One defect: the new public cusp lemma states the ℚ→ℝ embedding as `g.map (Rat.castHom ℝ)`, a second spelling of the map the rest of this lane canonically writes `Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.map (algebraMap ℚ ℝ)`.
